name: audit_and_break_code_with_gpt
description: Stage 4 Adversarial QA & AQI Doctor: Read-only audit of candidate git diff and modified files against Stage 2 blueprint and deterministic AQI findings. Auto-harvests git diff and modified files if omitted. Generates executable adversarial tests and surgical remediation prescriptions.

aqi_findings.description: Raw AST findings or report from local AQI compliance engine (node scripts/harness/aqi.mjs).

blueprint.description: Original technical blueprint and target file contracts established in Stage 2. If omitted, automatically loaded from latest Stage 2 execution or .ai/blueprint.md.

git_diff.description: The candidate code changes from Stage 3 (git diff -U3). If omitted, automatically harvested via git diff.

modified_files_context.description: Full source code of modified files to give the auditor complete lifecycle visibility (up to 15,000 tokens). If omitted, automatically harvested from modified files.

project_tech_stack.description: Project tech stack and testing framework (e.g. Node:test, Jest, Vitest, Pytest).

repo_path.description: Optional path to the git repository root. Defaults to auto-resolving from current working directory.

test_summary.description: Summary of baseline test execution results from Stage 3.
